title: Veggie Sausage with Herbed Polenta Fries & Tomato-Arugula Salad

steps.text: Halve each tube of polenta crosswise, then cut each half lengthwise into ½-inch thick "fries." Transfer to a large baking sheet pan, spreading the fries out in a single layer.
Drizzle fries with oil and season with spices; carefully toss to coat, then arrange on the baking sheet so that none of the fries are touching.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping fries halfway through, until golden brown and slightly crisp on the outside, 30-35 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the fries have about 12 minutes left of cooking, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until warmed through, about 5 minutes (or cook sausages according to package instructions). Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Halve tomatoes and place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and halve bell pepper crosswise, then slice into thin strips; add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
Add arugula to the bowl, along with the dressing, and toss to combine the salad; set aside.
Slice sausages crosswise into bite-sized pieces.
To serve, divide sausage, polenta fries, and salad between plates. Enjoy!
